trv-004.sentence: Lisbon Airport metro station is the final destination of the red line of the metro. The journey to the central Saldanha station takes about 16 minutes and less than 25 minutes are enough to get from the Airport to with a change to the green or blue lines.
Taxis cost about €16.00 from the airport to the city centre (Feb 2024). Charge is according to the meter, adding €1.20 per item of luggage.
Bus 44 takes you to the Oriente railway station in about 10 minutes, where you can change for metro and continue to the city centre.

vit-trv-003.sentence: Police report that an average of two accidents a day happen on the Chiang Mai-Pai road, and more in the rainy season.
It's a steep and winding drive, with lots of curves, so take a plastic bag and some motion sickness pills if you need them.
Minivans (150 baht) that leave hourly from Chiang Mai (Arcade terminal) and Mae Hong Son between 05:30 to 17:30.

trv-002.sentence: Brazil is one of a few countries that uses both 110 and 220 volts for everyday appliances.
Electric outlets usually accept both flat (North American), and round (European) plugs.
